limits: Local operator workspace only, fixed local-conversations organization and local-operator attribution. Gateplane-backed authentication/memberships are not activated.
Intake drafts are unverified and not consumed by planning/generation or approval. URLs are references and are never fetched.
Local browser recovery assumes the original workspace root remains configured at that origin. No cross-root or multi-tenant hosted recovery guarantee is claimed.
Unsubmitted fields remain in memory. A native leave-page warning is best effort, especially on mobile; save before closing.
Only Chromium desktop/mobile viewports were automated. No real iOS/Android or screen-reader conformance audit was performed.
The managed Turso resource was not re-probed and no deployment, live-model call, CRM access or outbound effect was performed in this slice.
Three selected HTTP mutations were exercised, not exhaustive mutation coverage.
No intake deletion or retention interface was added.
